item.title: Self-Hosted Speech-to-Text That Is Actually Useful
item.author: David Twizer
item.description: parrot: a minimal macOS dictation daemon. Hold Fn, speak, release - text appears at your cursor. Whisper on the Apple Neural Engine, fully on-device, running as a login daemon - plus a hotword hack that routes “Jarvis, …” straight into Claude Code.
